# Immigrant Invest

> > Global licensed agent specializing in citizenship-by-investment and residency-by-investment programs across Europe, Caribbean, Africa, and Asia.

Immigrant Invest is a legal consultancy firm offering comprehensive guidance on investment migration pathways, including citizenship programs, residence permits, real estate investments, and program comparisons. The firm maintains licensed agent status and operates offices across multiple jurisdictions including Malta, Portugal, Austria, Russia, Kazakhstan, and Cyprus.

## Key Topics

- Citizenship by Investment (CBI)
- Residency by Investment
- Golden Visa
- Second Passport
- Investment Immigration
- Real Estate Investment
- Visa-Free Travel
- Caribbean Programs
- European Programs
- Tax Optimization
- Schengen Area
- Licensed Agent
- Investment Requirements
- Passport Programs
- Family Sponsorship

## Caribbean Citizenship Programs

- [St Kitts and Nevis Citizenship by Investment Program (CBI) 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/citizenship-saint-kitts-and-nevis): Step-by-step guide to St Kitts and Nevis CBI program with costs, requirements, and procedures.
- [Grenada Citizenship by Investment 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/grenada-citizenship-by-investment): Comprehensive guide to Grenada's CBI program including requirements, costs, and visa benefits.
- [Antigua and Barbuda Citizenship by Investment Program (CBI) 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/antigua-and-barbuda-citizenship-by-investment): Detailed guide to Antigua and Barbuda CBI program with application procedures and benefits.
- [St Lucia Citizenship by Investment Program (CBI) 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/saint-lucia-citizenship-by-investment): Step-by-step guide to St Lucia CBI program including investment options and visa benefits.
- [Dominica Citizenship by Investment Program (CBI) 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/citizenship-dominica): Complete guide to Dominica CBI program with procedures, requirements, and investment options.

## European & Other Citizenship Programs

- [Malta Citizenship by Merit Naturalisation](https://immigrantinvest.com/malta-citizenship-merit): Guide to Malta citizenship by merit naturalisation pathway with eligibility and process details.
- [Turkey Citizenship by Investment Program 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/turkish-citizenship): Turkish citizenship program guide covering real estate and alternative investment options for E-2 visa.
- [Vanuatu Citizenship by Investment (CBI) 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/vanuatu-citizenship-by-investment): Guide to Vanuatu CBI program with $130,000+ investment requirements and fast 2+ month processing.
- [São Tomé and Príncipe Citizenship by Investment Program 2026](https://immigrantinvest.com/sao-tome-and-principe-citizenship): Guide to São Tomé and Príncipe CBI program with low investment thresholds and fast processing.
